'''Mechanical braking flaps''',<ref name="EGVV" /> also known as '''maneuvering flaps''',<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Maneuvering Flaps}}</ref> were flight components installed on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]]. There were two mechanical braking flaps on the craft, located on either wing above each [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. The flaps were used to increase the snowspeeder's maneuverability in combat<ref name="EGVV" /> and within a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="CCG" />
